changes.problem: Source fidelity remained imperfect because some source wording, purpose or application details, and abbreviation expansions were shortened or omitted.
changes.change: Added a source-order coverage checklist, explicit treatment of purpose and application text, and a completeness check for every abbreviation expansion.
changes.reason: A granular coverage inventory makes omissions visible before drafting and during the source-to-document traceability pass.

changes.problem: Numeric meaning was occasionally changed, including converting discrete supported values into a continuous range.
changes.change: Added a dedicated numeric-semantics rule and a final check for values, units, inequalities, alternatives, inclusivity, tolerances, and relationships between neighboring numbers.
changes.reason: Numeric transcription requires preserving the source relationship, not merely copying the endpoint values.

changes.problem: Generated documents sometimes introduced unsupported dimensions, extra requisites, repeated approvals, additional sections, or sample-derived formal pages.
changes.change: Turned the normative structure map into an explicit allowlist and added prohibitions and validation checks for unsupported physical attributes, duplicated formal elements, page furniture, and unrequested sections.
changes.reason: This prevents customary or sample-based content from expanding the requested and normatively applicable document scope.

changes.problem: Some verification entries were too generic or deferred measurable criteria to a future test program even when observable results were available.
changes.change: Required concrete observable outcomes whenever supported, prohibited generic verification phrases as sole criteria, and required retention of all supported method fragments when only part of a procedure is missing.
changes.reason: This improves verification usefulness without encouraging invented thresholds or procedures.

changes.problem: Introductory sections could become declarative summaries that lost source-supported scope, purpose, or operating context.
changes.change: Required introductory and purpose statements to enter the evidence ledger when they establish application, context, responsibility, or constraints.
changes.reason: These statements can carry material requirements even when they are not phrased as numbered technical obligations.

changes.problem: The existing validation guidance did not explicitly challenge every added structural element or duplicated formal block.
changes.change: Expanded the document-to-source pass to trace structural elements and remove duplicated formal pages, redundant requirements, and unrequested sections.
changes.reason: Bidirectional traceability should cover document structure as well as factual and technical content.
